digest.component_or_area: external-integration live-services test tier / LLM provider seam
propositions: The live_single_turn workflow returns status 'failed' instead of 'succeeded' in the external live-services tier.
coverage.llm_ran is False, indicating the live model call did not happen for the plan-review workflow engine.
These failures were previously masked by a SnapshotRefError (bug 8070) and became visible after snapshot resolution was fixed.
The failures are likely pre-existing rather than a regression from the snapshot fix commit.
The langfuse tracing round-trip sibling job passed, so this is not a blanket live-services outage.
Tests should either observe live LLM execution succeed or skip explicitly when a required credential is unavailable.
